args.text: The bug is in `logtrim/cli.py:16` — ISO dates (`2026-08-01`) are parsed with `%d-%b-%Y`. Fixing:

args.command: Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\app.log" -Value "2026-01-01 00:00:00 INFO old`n2026-08-20 00:00:00 INFO new"; python -m logtrim.cli "$env:TEMP\app.log"

args.text: Tests pass, but the CLI repro prints nothing — `cli.py` has no `__main__` entry point, so `python -m logtrim.cli` never calls `main()`. Adding the standard guard so the issue's repro path actually works:

args.command: Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\app.log" -Value "2026-01-01 00:00:00 INFO old`n2026-08-20 00:00:00 INFO new"; python -m logtrim.cli "$env:TEMP\app.log"; Get-Content "$env:TEMP\app.log"; python -m unittest discover -s tests
